about:
# CBS Indicator
A simple mod that makes it very obvious someone's using CBS (Click Between Steps)

## What this adds
- An indicator on the top-left that appears when CBS is on
- An indicator on the level endscreen
- Support for syzzi's [CBF](mod:syzzi.click_between_frames) mod
- Support for CoS

## Why?
With 2.208 adding Click Between Steps (CBS) and Click on Steps (CoS) to the base game, my [CBF Indicator](mod:xblazegmd.cbf-indicator) mod became useless as that mod was made specifically for syzzi's [Click Between Frames](mod:syzzi.click_between_frames) mod, which also became useless (or at least so I thought). This mod ports the functionality of my CBF Indicator mod to RobTop's CBS and CoS, as well as syzzi's CBF implementation.
